questions.statement: It is a sunny school morning in Bogota. What clothes do you wear on your upper body that usually has buttons and short sleeves?
questions.context: Choose the correct English word to complete the sentence.

options.feedback: 'finger' is a part of your hand, not an item of clothing you put on.
'shorts' are worn on the lower half of your body, not on the top half.
'foot' is a part of your leg used for standing, not a piece of clothing.
Correct! A 'shirt' is an item of clothing that you wear on the upper part of your body.

questions.explanation:
The word 'shirt' describes an item of clothing that you wear on your upper body. Learning clothing vocabulary is essential for describing what we wear every day for school in the city.

questions.statement: On a school morning in Cali, you need to wear these on your feet before you leave the house. What are they?
questions.context: Choose the correct English word to complete the sentence.

options.feedback: 'arm' is a part of your body, not something you wear on your feet to protect them.
Correct! 'shoes' are an item of clothing that you wear on your feet when walking outside.
'nose' is a part of your face used for smelling, not something you wear on your feet.
'hand' is the part of your arm with fingers, not clothing worn on your feet.

questions.explanation:
The word 'shoes' is used to describe the clothing item you wear on your feet. It is a fundamental word to know when talking about what to wear on a normal school morning in a Colombian city.

questions.context: Choose the correct English word to complete the sentence.

Correct! A 'hat' is an item of clothing you wear on your head to protect yourself from the sun.
'knee' is the joint in your leg, not an item of clothing worn on your head.
'leg' is the part of your body used for walking, not a protective item for your head.

questions.explanation:

questions.statement: On a regular school morning in Medellin, a girl decides to wear a single piece of clothing that covers her body and legs. What is it?
questions.context: Choose the correct English word to complete the sentence.

options.feedback: Correct! A 'dress' is a single piece of clothing that typically covers the body and extends down over the legs.
'neck' is the body part connecting the head to the body, not a piece of clothing.
'mouth' is part of the face, not a piece of clothing you put on your body.
'teeth' are inside the mouth, not a type of clothing worn on a school morning.

questions.explanation:
The word 'dress' refers to a piece of clothing for girls or women that covers both the top and bottom half. It is a common word needed to describe everyday school clothing choices in Colombia.

'chin' is the bottom part of your face, not a piece of clothing for your legs.

questions.context: Choose the correct English word to complete the sentence.

options.feedback: Correct! 'socks' are soft clothing items you wear on your feet, inside your shoes.
'eye' is the body part you use for seeing, not a clothing item for your feet.
'thumb' is a part of your hand, not something you wear inside your shoes.
'cheek' is a part of your face, not an item of clothing for your feet.

questions.context: Choose the correct English word to complete the sentence.

options.feedback: Correct! A 'jacket' is a warm outer piece of clothing with sleeves, worn over your shirt.

'shoulder' is the body part where the arm joins the body, not a clothing item.
'stomach' is a part of the body, not a piece of clothing worn over a shirt.
